# LumiBase

> LumiBase is a Content Operating System — an edge-native, AI-native headless CMS where governed AI agents operate content against declarative SLOs (intents) while humans set intent, taste, and hold the veto. Open-source (MIT), multi-tenant by default, runs on Cloudflare Workers or self-hosted Docker.

LumiBase runs content APIs at the edge — close to users — instead of on a central server, with dual deployment (Cloudflare Workers and Docker) and a type-safe REST + GraphQL surface. Beyond storage, agents reconcile content toward the intents you declare, earning autonomy on a trust ladder (L0 human-in-the-loop → L4 autopilot) as they prove reliable, and every change carries full provenance. It exposes an MCP server for agent integrations, a Change Data Capture (CDC) change feed, and signed extensions.
